plugins.description: DSH 插件开关/删除管理器：设置页直接启用停用、删除插件，支持 bundle 整组开关
plugins.author: tuogusa

plugins.name: dsh-session-tags
plugins.description: DSH 会话标签：给会话打标签并按 tag 搜索管理
plugins.author: tuogusa

plugins.name: dsh-deepseek-balance
plugins.description: 实时显示 DeepSeek 开发平台余额
plugins.author: MatsMQ

plugins.name: omdsh-base
plugins.description: DeepSeek Harness Web GUI 的会话模式系统：模式注册表、模式切换器与侧边栏圆点，自带 Work 模式
plugins.author: omdsh-plugins
plugins.notes: 需要全局 dsh CLI 与 web profile；安装后重启 dsh web 生效。配合 omdsh-justchat / omdsh-code 可组成 Chat/Work/Code 模式切换。

plugins.name: dsh-sticky-notes
plugins.description: 灵感便签（Sticky Notes）：AI 思考/运行时随手记想法，一键或合并发送/转发到任意对话——走官方排队通道，目标 AI 忙碌时自动排队、不打断；数据 localStorage+宿主文件双写，重启不丢；支持导出 TXT/JSON/MD；界面语言跟随 DSH（zh/en 双语）。
plugins.author: lastplayer82

plugins.name: dsh-xingye
plugins.description: Turns a DeepSeek Harness session into a local chat agent: characters and personas, several archive threads per character, an undoable/rewindable local transcript, and an event book.
plugins.author: Iambatman1928

plugins.name: dsh-plugin-vision-toolkit
plugins.description: Vision-toolkit bridge.
plugins.author: YYTbit

plugins.name: dsh-fork-to-preset
plugins.description: Fork any session into a different agent preset from the conversation header: a preset picker creates a new child session mounted on the chosen preset, inheriting the source session's completed turns.
plugins.author: bpc-oss

plugins.name: dsh-req-miner
plugins.description: Requirements-mining sidebar plugin: per-session floating interview window driven by a continuable subagent (decision tree + frontier questions), reads the bound session's workspace and recent context, one-click return of the summarized requirement prompt to the composer. Install: `github:nortejiang-tech/dsh-req-miner`.
plugins.author: nortejiang-tech

plugins.name: dsh-paseo-mobile
plugins.description: Connect your phone to dsh via Paseo: one-command setup registers dsh as a Paseo provider (zero-dependency ACP bridge), then scan the pairing QR in the Paseo mobile app. Model-agnostic: follows your existing dsh model config; mirrors dsh web sessions to the phone with context-aware follow-ups.
plugins.author: vvlife
plugins.notes: 模型无关，不改 dsh 模型配置（与 dsh-agnes-paseo 互补）。装完在 profile 目录跑 pnpm exec dsh-paseo-mobile-setup --restart-daemon：复制 ACP 桥、探测当前默认模型写 provider.json、注册 Paseo provider；然后 paseo daemon pair 出二维码，手机 Paseo App 扫码即连。dsh web 会话可在 Paseo 导入镜像到手机，追问带上下文注入；Paseo 新建 agent 的回合间不保留上下文。

plugins.name: dsh-cert-mcp
plugins.description: Read-only MCP server over the DSH plugin-certification registry: query a plugin certification grade, its snapshot and the five-dimension evidence behind it.
plugins.author: PerryLink

plugins.name: dsh-reach
plugins.description: Mirrors approval and question cards to IM chat (WeChat iLink first) and answers them from chat, with a session console.
plugins.author: PerryLink

plugins.name: dsh-plugin-doctor
plugins.description: Zero-dependency detector for DSH plugins: package-structure checks, cordis contract scanning, a keyless headless sandbox smoke run and ecosystem-listing verification in one pass.
plugins.author: PerryLink

plugins.name: dsh-plugin-upgrade
plugins.description: Upgrade skill for DSH plugin authors: one package carries one corridor index that reads the caller peer range and routes it to the matching closed corridor card, plus a zero-dependency seam scanner.
plugins.author: PerryLink

plugins.name: dsh-plugin-kit
plugins.description: Shared zero-runtime-dependency toolkit for plugin authors: a provider registry seam, approval gates and a new-plugin skeleton.
plugins.author: PerryLink

plugins.name: dsh-mini-games
plugins.description: Pure-frontend mini-game collection in the web details panel: guess-the-number, 2048, minesweeper (`dsh plugin --profile web add dsh-mini-games`).
plugins.author: aga-j

plugins.name: dsh-deploy-share
plugins.description: HTML preview deploy & share buttons: one-click deploy to free account-less anonymous hosting and copy the live link.
plugins.author: vvlife
plugins.notes: 依赖 dsh-better-sidebar（经 ctx.betterSidebar 注册高优先级 HTML viewer）。部署经插件 host 路由 /deploy-share/upload 转发免账号托管（html.cafe → catbox.moe → envs.sh），上传后回读校验 text/html + CSP 放行内联脚本 + 响应体含内容标记，失败自动换下一家。装完重启 dsh web。

plugins.name: dsh-session-nav
plugins.description: 会话对话快捷导航：右侧悬浮按钮，hover 弹出完整历史提问列表，点击快速跳转
plugins.author: tuogusa
plugins.notes: 兼容 Profile: web；git 安装需在 profile 的 pnpm-workspace.yaml 添加 allowBuilds；装完重启 + Ctrl+Shift+R

plugins.name: omdsh-code
plugins.description: Code 模式：以 harness 自带终端作为中间列，在会话工作区里运行
plugins.author: omdsh-plugins
plugins.notes: 依赖 omdsh-base 的模式切换器；终端运行在独立 profile（默认 omdsh-tui，需按该仓库说明安装）。

plugins.name: omdsh-sidepanel
plugins.description: Work 模式下的右侧文件树与底部终端侧栏
plugins.author: omdsh-plugins
plugins.notes: 仅 Work 模式显示；可选依赖 omdsh-remdev（远程开发服务）。

plugins.name: omdsh-sidechat
plugins.description: 侧边对话：锚定当前浏览内容，在独立会话中提问，不打扰主会话
plugins.author: omdsh-plugins

plugins.name: omdsh-usage
plugins.description: 会话/项目花费与账户余额一览
plugins.author: omdsh-plugins

plugins.name: omdsh-editor
plugins.description: 在会话头部一键用本机编辑器/终端/文件管理器打开项目目录
plugins.author: omdsh-plugins

plugins.name: omdsh-remdev
plugins.description: 远程开发：把工作区接到 SSH 服务器，文件、终端与智能体都在远端运行
plugins.author: omdsh-plugins
plugins.notes: 需目标服务器可 SSH 登录；自动安装 Node/pnpm 与 Code 终端 profile。

plugins.name: omdsh-remctrl
plugins.description: 远程控制：独立端口的第二入口，设备配对 + 分级方法白名单
plugins.author: omdsh-plugins
plugins.notes: 当前为 M0（门与锁）；面向 tailnet 内手机远程查看会话与审批。

plugins.name: omdsh-justchat
plugins.description: Chat 模式：免选项目目录直接开聊，会话统一收纳在托管工作区
plugins.author: omdsh-plugins
plugins.notes: 提供 Chat 与 Work 两种模式。

plugins.name: omdsh-shortcuts
plugins.description: 一键绑定命令的快捷键系统，桌面菜单与网页共用一份配置
plugins.author: omdsh-plugins

plugins.name: dsh-prompt-optimize
plugins.description: 对 composer 当前草稿做辅助 LLM 改写；点击只替换草稿，不发送消息、不开回合
plugins.author: peterliucius
plugins.notes: 兼容 Profile: web（占用 conversation.input.right，需要已有 web Client Remote gateway）；不兼容默认 headless（无 composer UI）。Windows 上若 git 依赖 symlink 报 EPERM，可在 pnpm-workspace.yaml 加 packageImportMethod: copy。

plugins.name: omdsh-plughub
plugins.description: omdsh 插件中心：在设置页里安装、移除并配置整套 omdsh 插件
plugins.author: omdsh-plugins
plugins.notes: npm 已发布；安装后重启生效，Settings → Plugins → OMDSH Plugins 中可安装其余插件。

plugins.name: dsh-voice-chat
plugins.description: 语音对话：语音输入（Web SpeechRecognition）+ 朗读回复（TTS），支持语速/音调调节，纯本地无 API Key
plugins.author: lak321

plugins.name: dsh-screen-agent
plugins.description: 桌面与屏幕自动化：全屏截图、Windows OCR、鼠标点击/拖拽、键盘输入、窗口激活，以及画图工具自动化（加速度补偿/画布定位/多段绘制）
plugins.author: lak321

plugins.name: dsh-tanqi
plugins.description: 探奇（英文名 Curio）：AI 动态生成不重复的冷知识与奇妙事实，每次包含大公司病/产品决策困局/行业潜规则类内容，每条可深入两层并联想类似知识点，历史全部保留在本地。
plugins.author: lastplayer82

plugins.name: dsh-upload
plugins.description: 给 DeepSeek Harness Web 加真正的上传按钮:点 📎 选本地文件,字节落盘到会话工作区 .uploads/<会话ID>/,绝对路径追加进输入框(AI 用 fs 工具直接读取)。
plugins.author: Ei-Ayw

plugins.name: dsh-word-docs
plugins.description: DeepSeek Harness 的 Word 文档工具:生成、编辑、提取、统计、转 PDF .docx,纯 Python 标准库实现,零依赖。
plugins.author: Ei-Ayw

plugins.name: dsh-wechat
plugins.description: DSH插件，将微信私聊消息桥接到DSH，支持文本、图片、文件、音视频的双向传输。目标是在微信端还原DSH的原生体验
plugins.author: PerryLink

plugins.name: dsh-personal-directive
plugins.description: harness 破甲插件安装即用
plugins.author: PerryLink
